verdict: The biggest movement this period is Instagram's 219.73% spike in leads week-over-week, likely driven by increased Meta creative delivery or budget reallocation, while overall efficiency improved with CPL dropping 24.32% in the last 7 days to a 28-day average of $103.54 across 36 leads on $3,727.45 in spend. Notably, Google Ads generated only 3 conversions on $1,891.59 in spend, suggesting the "Leads - Search Campaign" at $1,502.59 warrants a close review of conversion tracking or bid strategy.

performance.verdict: SOW is 3+ months overdue; paid efficiency improving but attribution remains unverified.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue since July–Sept 2026: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting, and Shoot 1 — all unconfirmed complete.
CPL fell 24.32% 7d vs prior 7d to a 28-day average of $103.54; however all 36 leads attributed to Meta — Google Ads shows only 3 conversions on $1,891.59 spend, making blended CPL misleading.

Google Ads delivered only 3 conversions on $1,891.59 (28d), a cost-per-conversion of ~$630. 3-day signal (Oct 29–31): spend collapsed to $32.86/$50.10/$29.98 with 0 leads — consistent with budget throttle or tracking failure, not campaign performance.

GHL shows 104 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days. Meta delivered 36 leads in the same window — opps flat relative to contacts (362) signals an intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped 30.23% 7d vs prior 7d to 137 total (28d); last 2 days (Oct 30–31) show 0 GBP actions, consistent with weekend suppression but worth monitoring into weekdays.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking immediately; $1,891.59 spend with 3 conversions likely reflects a pixel/tag failure, not true performance.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $1,891.59 over 28 days and recorded only 3 conversions — a ~$630 cost-per-conversion that does not match Meta's $103.54 CPL on the same audience pool. The SOW required conversion actions and GTM install by July 31; this milestone is unconfirmed complete. Nacer/Web to verify the Google tag fires on the thank-you or form-confirmation page and that the conversion action is linked in the account. Success check: Google Ads reports ≥1 verified conversion within 7 days of the fix, confirmed by Nov 8.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 362 contacts, 104 opps, 0 appointments, 0 won — route and speed-to-lead SLA must be audited before scaling any spend.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 362 contacts and 104 opportunities created over 28 days, but 0 appointments booked and 0 cases won. This is an intake-process failure, not an ads problem — leads are arriving but not converting to consultations. Per SOW Month 1, routing, speed-to-lead under 5 min, and calendar booking should already be live; confirm these automations are active and test a lead end-to-end. Success check: at least 5 appointments appear in GHL within the next 7 days (by Nov 8) as evidence the funnel is functioning.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL for 3 more days before scaling; $103.54 CPL trend is positive but Google attribution void means true blended efficiency is unknown.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is driving all 36 attributed leads at a 28-day CPL of $103.54, down 24.32% week-over-week — a positive efficiency trend. However, Google Ads tracking appears broken, so the true blended CPL and channel split are unverifiable. Do not scale Meta budget until Google conversion tracking is confirmed fixed (S1) and baseline CPL can be measured cleanly across both channels. Re-check on Nov 4 using the 3-day lead and CPL signal from Oct 31–Nov 3.
